aliases: Chinese People's Liberation Army Air Force Communication Non commissioned Officer School

evidence.summary: CASI describes the Air Force Communication NCO Academy in Dalian as a PLA Air Force school for communications non-commissioned officers, founded in 1986 as one of the PLA’s first NCO schools and reporting to PLA Air Force headquarters since 2001.
The academy has reported to PLA Air Force headquarters since 2001.

sources.title: The People’s Liberation Army’s 37 Academic Institutions (2020), pp. 200–201
sources.publisher: China Aerospace Studies Institute, US Air Force Air University
